description: Figure 4 illustrates the MC1 scores of SEA as a function of the number of demonstrations used, with a higher score indicating better performance. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations” and spans from 0 to 2000 on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled “MC1” and ranges from approximately 37 to 39, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers representing “Linear SAE,” a dashed pink line with circular markers representing “LLaMA-2-chat-7B,” and a dashed cyan line with circular markers representing “ICD.” The “Linear SAE” line starts at an MC1 score of approximately 37.1 at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 38.1 at 1000 demonstrations, dips slightly to around 38.0 at 1500 demonstrations, and then sharply increases to approximately 39.1 at 2000 demonstrations. The “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” line remains nearly flat, hovering just above an MC1 score of 37.0 throughout the entire range. The “ICD” line is nearly flat, staying at a constant MC1 score of approximately 37.9 across all demonstration counts. A text annotation near the top of the plot indicates “ICD (Prompt version)” is associated with the cyan line.
